name: Billy Doe Meats
verdict: The biggest movement this period is a sharp -83.85% drop in GBP activity over the last 7 days, likely driven by reduced local search visibility or a lull in seasonal demand, though the profile still generated 428 total actions (43 calls, 88 directions, 297 web clicks) over 28 days. Paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend and zero leads, suggesting campaigns are paused and all traffic is organic.

performance.verdict: Paid is dark; organic holds but GBP is collapsing — relaunch is urgent.

findings.text: All paid spend is $0 for the full 28-day window. Zero Meta, zero Google — no purchases, no ROAS, no revenue attributable to paid.
OVERDUE: Live-Cooking Event Shoot 1 was due 2026-08-14 with no confirmed completion — 16 days past deadline, blocking fresh creative pipeline.
GBP actions collapsed -83.85% in the last 7 days; last 3 days show 10, 0, 0 vs prior 3-day avg of ~9 — a hard stop, not seasonal drift.
GA4 sessions are up +12.84% (7d delta), averaging ~285/day last 3 days vs ~252 prior 3 — organic site interest is rising while paid is off.
Purchases and revenue read $0 for all 28 days in series — likely a Shopify/Meta pixel disconnect, not true zero; Windsor reconciliation needed.

suggestions.text: Reactivate Meta campaigns immediately; $0 spend for 28 days is a full stop against a $1,000–1,500/mo SOW commitment.
suggestions.monday_update: Meta has recorded $0 spend for the entire 28-day window through 2026-08-29, against a contracted ~$1,000–1,500/mo ad spend commitment. Action: confirm campaign pause reason with Sohib/Nacer and reactivate at the previously tested daily budget (scaled from the 3.8–4.6x test phase). Success check: confirm >$0 spend and at least 1 attributed purchase within 3 days of relaunch (by 2026-09-02). Windsor/Meta attribution is primary — do not use Shopify purchase count alone.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP collapse: last 3 days show 10, 0, 0 actions — check for suspended profile or removed listing.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped -83.85% (7d delta) and hit 0 on 2026-08-27 and 2026-08-28. This is not a gradual decline — it is an abrupt stop consistent with a profile suspension, listing removal, or NAP (name/address/phone) flag. Action: log into Google Business Profile dashboard immediately and check for any suspension notice or policy alert. Success check: actions return above 15/day within 7 days of any corrective action (by 2026-09-06).

suggestions.text: Watch purchases/revenue data integrity; $0 for 28 days likely reflects pixel gap, not true sales silence — confirm before acting.
suggestions.monday_update: The series shows $0 purchases and $0 revenue for all 28 days despite 7,404 GA4 sessions and 3,319 reported conversions in the same window — a near-impossible combination if the store is live. Meta purchase events are known to fire inconsistently via Shopify (documented issue). Action: run a Windsor vs Shopify orders reconciliation for Aug 1–29 to determine actual order volume before any ROAS-based scaling decision. Re-check by 2026-09-03; if reconciliation shows real purchases, escalate to a pixel fix task immediately.
